the stability analysis of the PV inverter system can be done with state-space modeling, and the stability trend due the change of both source voltage and source impedance can be detected with this approach, which is quite difficult to be predicted with the transfer function approach.
a state-space modeling approach can be used for stability analysis of a complete PV inverter system.

modeling, analysis, and design of a grid-tied PV inverter system.
the modeling and control of a complete PV inverter system.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed state-space modeling approach can provide a better insight into the stability analysis of a PV inverter system and the stability trend with respect to different operating conditions.
the proposed state-space modeling and stability analysis can provide more insight into the stability of a grid-tie inductor-capacitor (LC) filter based PV inverter system.

the proposed state-space modeling approach is a very powerful tool for the analysis of the stability trend of the grid-tie PV inverters with different irradiation conditions, PV output voltage levels, and current-loop gains and the design of the controller for the grid-tie inverters.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the stability of a PV inverter system can be predicted by state-space modeling and the stability trend due the change of the source voltage and source impedance can be observed by the eigenvalue analysis.
the stability trend can be predicted by eigenvalues and the state-space model can be utilized to analyze the stability of a complete PV inverter system.
the eigenvalue analysis is very useful in stability analysis for PV inverters, and it can be applied to the design of a stable control system.
